goals.title: Achieve system-AI activation with governed interaction boundaries
goals.objective: Advance StegVerse-002 from FEDERATION_REGISTERED to SYSTEM_AI_ACTIVE by producing the missing independent evidence chain without treating inference as a governed object or granting itself authority to declare success.
success_predicates: Canonical repo-HeartBeat federation receipt exists and shows StegVerse-002/micro-node-runtime present, valid, fresh, nonfailed, and non-dependency-blocked.

A real local/private StegVerse-002 inference execution is observed and the applicable interaction/route boundary is separately admitted by TV/TVC and carried through the canonical LLM-adapter route with measured usage evidence.
Master Records provider-usage reconstruction PASS refers to the same execution and interaction boundary.
Master Records transition reconstruction PASS refers to the same execution and interaction boundary.
The organization system-AI registry is advanced to SYSTEM_AI_ACTIVE only after independent evidence satisfies all activation predicates.
forbidden_shortcuts: Treat repository presence as runtime presence
Treat HeartBeat registration as HeartBeat presence proof
Treat inference itself as governance-admitted or governance-denied
Treat CI/workflow success as authentic runtime evidence
Create a second heartbeat, credential authority, route authority, or custody authority

successor_goal.objective: Continuously identify evidence-backed StegVerse ecosystem coherence gaps and propose or execute only separately authorized bounded remediation while preserving fail-closed governance at applicable interaction boundaries.
